subject: BrightLoop POC: scheduling hands-on prompt review & kickoff
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@brightloop.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightloop.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — proposed kickoff window

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Samir and I chatted and we'd like to move forward with a short POC to validate prompt routing and a light load test. Goals are:

- Walk through our prompt inventory and surface edge cases
- Verify structured output/guardrail behaviour for our routing rules
- Run a modest load test to sanity-check latency/cost for production estimates

We're aiming for a hands-on kickoff (2.5 hours) where our engineers bring prompts and sample data. Proposed windows:

- Tue 6/29, 10:00–12:30 PT
- Wed 6/30, 13:00–15:30 PT
- Thu 7/1, 09:00–11:30 PT

If none of those work, happy to propose alternatives. Also: can you confirm what you need from our side for the prompt inventory (format, size limits) and whether a dedicated load test engineer should join?

Attached: high-level POC objectives (PDF) — attaching as a stub below.

[Attachment: brightloop_poc_objectives.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Integrations
BrightLoop
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@brightloop.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — proposed kickoff window

Elena — thanks for the clear goals. All those windows look workable. Quick notes and asks before we lock a time: 

- We recommend a 2.5 hour hands-on workshop (agenda below).
- For prompt inventory: CSV with columns [prompt_id, use_case, example_input, expected_output, failure_modes]. Max file ~10k rows is fine — smaller is better for the workshop.
- Please include any structured-output schema you expect (JSON schema if available).
- For load test: Ben (cc'd) will run the test; if BrightLoop can provide typical token-distribution estimates (avg tokens/request, peak RPS) that helps size the test.

Proposed agenda (we'll iterate):
1) 10m — intros & goals
2) 30m — prompt inventory walkthrough (you present key prompt groups)
3) 45m — guardrails & structured output workshop (schema review, test examples)
4) 30m — routing decisions and model variants (latency vs cost trade-offs)
5) 20m — light load test plan (setup + quick run)
6) 15m — next steps, rollouts, owners

Would you prefer Tue 6/29 10:00 PT or Wed 6/30 13:00 PT? If Wed works for you we'll tentatively book 2:30 hours and share a calendar invite.

Thanks — I can adjust agenda if you want more time on routing.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@brightloop.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightloop.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — proposed kickoff window

Jonas — Wed 6/30 13:00 PT works best for the team. I've attached a first-pass prompt inventory (subset) and our expected JSON schema for structured outputs. The inventory is intentionally selective; we'll bring more examples during the session.

Attachments (stubs):
- prompt_inventory.csv (CSV)
- brightloop_output_schema.json (JSON)

For load testing: our SRE suggests we start with a 30 RPS sustained run for 5 minutes and a couple of brief peaks at 100 RPS to exercise autoscaling. Let me know if that's feasible.

I'll share the attendee list and calendar once I confirm with procurement.

Best,
Elena
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — proposed kickoff window

Quick conflict flag: I have a standing leadership review at 13:00 PT on 6/30. I can attend the first hour and then drop — would you prefer we shift the kickoff to 10:00–12:30 PT on 6/30 instead, or keep 13:00 and I'll hand off the routing/guardrails section to Marissa for the middle block?

Ben — can you confirm load-test availability for Wed afternoon? If not, propose Tue morning options.

Karthik Iyer

Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC with Redwood — proposed kickoff window

Thanks for the quick responses — consolidation below and final ask items.

Final date/time: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 10:00–12:30 PT (we moved earlier to keep Karthik for the full workshop). I'll send the calendar invite shortly.

Confirmed attendees (prelim):
- BrightLoop: Elena Rossi, Samir Patel, 2x SWE (TBD)
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (solutions), Marissa Cole (AM), Karthik Iyer (integration), Ben Carter (load testing)

Final agenda (attached):
- 10:00 — intros & objectives
- 10:10 — prompt inventory walkthrough (BrightLoop lead)
- 10:40 — structured-output & guardrails (schema review + live examples)
- 11:25 — routing & model variant tradeoffs (live config examples)
- 11:55 — light load test dry-run & quick execution (Ben leads)
- 12:15 — wrap, owners, next steps

Action items for BrightLoop before the session:
- Upload prompt_inventory.csv with up to ~500 sample rows (we received the partial file — thanks)
- Share the JSON schema for expected structured output (we received the file — thanks)
- Confirm attendee list and token distribution estimates (avg tokens/request, expected peak RPS)

Attachments: workshop_agenda.pdf (PDF stub), prompt_inventory.csv (partial)

We'll run a short smoke test at 11:55 PT so please ensure any required network allowlists are done. Calendar invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightloop-poc-kickoff

Looking forward — we'll also record the session for your product team.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
